title: Who Should Set the Standards? Analysing Censored Arabic Content on Facebook during the Palestine-Israel Conflict
reasoning: The paper is an empirical study investigating user perceptions of content moderation and algorithmic bias. Although it categorizes some content under 'Religious groups' and 'Jews' as part of its thematic analysis of the Israel-Palestine conflict, it does not aim to evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics themselves.
